intro.en: Medical equipment cable assemblies connect sensors, patient-monitoring accessories, diagnostic instruments, therapy equipment, laboratory systems and internal electronics. The category includes many electrical and mechanical constructions; suitability is defined by the device manufacturer, intended use and released specification—not by a generic ‘medical cable’ label.
intro.zh: 医疗设备电缆组件用于连接传感器、患者监护附件、诊断仪器、治疗设备、实验室系统与设备内部电子部件。该小类包含多种电气和机械结构；是否适用应由设备制造商、预期用途与放行规范共同确定，而不能仅凭“医疗线缆”这一通用名称判断。

knowledge.en: A cable can carry low-level physiological signals, digital data, power, pneumatic tubing or several functions in one hybrid assembly. Patient proximity, applied-part classification, cleaning chemistry, flexing, connector touch-proofing, EMC, leakage-current paths and service life can change the design. Relevant IEC, ISO, AAMI, UL or customer requirements must be flowed down by exact edition and scope.
knowledge.zh: 一根组件可能传输低电平生理信号、数字数据、电源、气路，或在混合结构中同时承担多种功能。患者接近程度、应用部分分类、清洁化学品、弯折、连接器防触电、EMC、漏电流路径与使用寿命都会改变设计。适用的 IEC、ISO、AAMI、UL 或客户要求必须按准确版本与范围逐项下达。

notes.en: Provide the device and intended-use description, patient-contact boundary, mating interfaces and keying, circuit and shield schedule, signal levels and bandwidth, voltage/current, cable geometry, cleaning or disinfection method, flex and pull duty, environmental limits, material restrictions, labeling, traceability, sample quantity and the approved verification plan.
notes.zh: 请提供设备与预期用途说明、患者接触边界、对插接口与防错方式、回路和屏蔽表、信号电平与带宽、电压/电流、线缆几何、清洁或消毒方法、弯折与拉力工况、环境限值、材料限制、标签、追溯、样品数量及批准的验证计划。

delivery.en: Medical-device-related projects are reviewed individually. We can build engineering samples and controlled production assemblies to the agreed file package, but device registration, biological evaluation, electrical-safety certification and clinical or regulatory approval remain the responsibility of the legal manufacturer and qualified laboratories unless separately contracted and evidenced.
delivery.zh: 医疗器械相关项目需逐项审核。我们可依据约定文件包制作工程样品与受控量产组件，但器械注册、生物学评价、电气安全认证、临床或法规批准仍由法定制造商与具备资质的实验室负责，除非另有合同和证据明确约定。

introduction.en: Define the Device Context Before the Cable
introduction.zh: 先定义器械场景，再定义线缆

faq.zh: 医疗设备电缆组件常见问题

subtitle.en: From patient-side leads to internal equipment interconnects
subtitle.zh: 从患者侧导联到设备内部互连

lead.en: Start with the device risk and intended use, then define signal, power, materials, cleaning, handling and evidence. One category can cover bedside monitoring, imaging, therapy, laboratory automation and portable care—each with a different construction baseline.
lead.zh: 先从设备风险与预期用途出发，再定义信号、电源、材料、清洁、操作和证据要求。一个小类可覆盖床旁监护、影像、治疗、实验室自动化与便携医疗，但每种用途都有不同的结构基线。

title.en: One category spans patient-side, equipment-side and internal assemblies
title.zh: 一个小类覆盖患者侧、设备侧与内部组件

copy.en: Medical equipment wiring ranges from detachable ECG and SpO₂ leads to ultrasound probe tails, NIBP hoses with signal conductors, foot-switch cables, endoscope or therapy handpiece connections, imaging-system interconnects and internal power or data harnesses. Connector family, circuit count and appearance alone do not establish interchangeability. The device model, accessory identification, pin assignment and risk-control function must stay linked.
copy.zh: 医疗设备布线可从可拆卸 ECG 与 SpO₂ 导联，延伸到超声探头尾线、含信号导体的 NIBP 管线、脚踏开关线、内窥镜或治疗手柄连接、影像系统互连，以及设备内部电源或数据线束。连接器系列、回路数量与外观都不足以证明可互换，设备型号、附件标识、针脚分配和风险控制功能必须始终关联。

copy.en: Identify patient-side, operator-accessible, internal, service-only and mains-related interfaces before choosing construction.
copy.zh: 选结构前先区分患者侧、操作者可触及、设备内部、仅维修与电网相关接口。

copy.en: A similar plug must not be presented as compatible without model, pinout and functional confirmation.
copy.zh: 外观相似的插头不得在未确认型号、针脚和功能前宣称兼容。

title.en: Low-level physiological signals need stable contact and controlled noise
title.zh: 低电平生理信号需要稳定接触与受控噪声

copy.en: ECG, EEG, EMG, temperature, SpO₂ and other monitoring leads work close to the patient and often carry small signals. Conductor resistance, triboelectric noise, cable capacitance, shielding, lead identification, electrode attachment and motion artefact can affect the complete signal chain. Snap, clip, pinch, DIN-style and proprietary monitor interfaces are selected from the device specification rather than visual similarity.
copy.zh: ECG、EEG、EMG、体温、SpO₂ 等监护导联靠近患者，且常传输微小信号。导体电阻、摩擦电噪声、电缆电容、屏蔽、导联标识、电极连接与运动伪差都可能影响完整信号链。按扣、夹子、夹持式、DIN 类及专用监护接口应依据设备规范选定，而不是依靠外观相似判断。

copy.en: Color, text, channel name and connector keying are coordinated with the target device and market convention.
copy.zh: 颜色、文字、通道名称与连接器防错需与目标设备及市场惯例协调。

copy.en: Repeated coiling, bed-rail contact, patient movement and disconnection at the grip influence flex and strain-relief geometry.
copy.zh: 反复盘绕、接触床栏、患者移动及握持处拔插都会影响弯折与应力消除结构。

title.en: Bandwidth, timing and electromagnetic environment define the interconnect
title.zh: 带宽、时序与电磁环境共同定义互连

copy.en: Ultrasound, X-ray, CT, MRI support equipment and optical diagnostic systems may use coaxial, twinaxial, twisted-pair, fiber, hybrid power/data or high-density internal assemblies. Characteristic impedance, skew, insertion loss, shield continuity, connector launch geometry and cable routing are reviewed with the equipment architecture. MRI-zone use or other special environments require an explicit material and compatibility review; a general cable page cannot establish suitability.
copy.zh: 超声、X 射线、CT、MRI 配套设备与光学诊断系统可能使用同轴、双轴、双绞、光纤、混合电源/数据或高密度内部组件。特性阻抗、时延偏差、插入损耗、屏蔽连续性、连接器过渡结构与走线需结合设备架构审核。MRI 区域或其他特殊环境还需明确进行材料和兼容性评估，通用产品页面不能证明适用。

copy.en: Cable, connector, termination and enclosure bonding are treated as one path for higher-frequency signals.
copy.zh: 对较高频信号，应将电缆、连接器、端接与机壳搭接作为一条完整路径处理。

copy.en: Pairing, return paths, physical spacing and shield termination are set before the harness route is frozen.
copy.zh: 在线束路线冻结前确定配对、回流路径、物理间距与屏蔽端接。

title.en: Handpieces, foot controls and moving equipment add mechanical risk
title.zh: 手柄、脚控与移动设备带来额外机械风险

copy.en: Surgical tools, therapy applicators, examination lamps, pumps, dental equipment and powered carts can expose cables to repeated flexing, rolling loads, cleaning fluids, tight storage and fast connection. The assembly may also carry interlock, identification or temperature-sensing circuits. Grip geometry, bend transition, connector retention, snag resistance and field-replacement method are part of usability and risk control, not decoration.
copy.zh: 手术工具、治疗施加器、检查灯、泵、牙科设备与移动设备可能使电缆经历反复弯折、滚轮碾压、清洁液、狭小收纳和快速连接。组件还可能承载互锁、识别或温度检测回路。握持几何、弯曲过渡、连接器保持、防勾挂与现场更换方式属于可用性和风险控制，而不是装饰。

copy.en: Bend radius, torsion, pull direction, cycle count and storage method are captured from actual use.
copy.zh: 从实际使用中提取弯曲半径、扭转、拉力方向、循环次数与收纳方式。

copy.en: Retention must resist accidental separation without making emergency or service disconnection unsafe.
copy.zh: 保持力既要抵抗意外脱开，也不能让紧急或维修断开变得不安全。

title.en: Automation harnesses combine motion, sensing, fluidics and service access
title.zh: 自动化线束同时服务运动、传感、流体与维护

copy.en: Analyzers, sample handlers, centrifuges, incubators and laboratory robots use internal harnesses for motors, encoders, heaters, valves, pumps, optical sensors, bar-code readers and communication modules. Compact routing must still allow service access and avoid pinch points, hot zones, reagents and moving mechanisms. In vitro diagnostic equipment has its own applicable requirements and should not be assumed to follow every medical-electrical rule in the same way.
copy.zh: 分析仪、样本处理设备、离心机、培养设备与实验室机器人通过内部线束连接电机、编码器、加热器、阀、泵、光学传感器、条码读头与通信模块。紧凑走线仍需保留维护空间，并避开夹点、热区、试剂与运动机构。体外诊断设备有自身适用要求，不能假定其与所有医用电气设备采用完全相同的规则。

copy.en: Connector access, replacement sequence, labels and test points are planned with the equipment service procedure.
copy.zh: 连接器可达性、更换顺序、标签与测试点应和设备维修程序一起规划。

copy.en: Leak paths, condensation, reagent exposure and washdown boundaries influence routing and protection.
copy.zh: 泄漏路径、冷凝、试剂暴露与清洗边界会影响走线和防护。

title.en: Signal, power and movement each demand a different cable core
title.zh: 信号、电源与运动分别需要不同芯线结构

copy.en: Fine-strand copper can support flexibility, while plated conductors may be selected for temperature, termination or corrosion conditions. Pair twist, coaxial geometry, drain wire, foil, braid and hybrid shields solve different coupling problems. Conductor gauge is calculated from current, resistance, voltage drop, temperature, bundle size and fault conditions; shielding is defined by frequency and grounding strategy rather than added generically.
copy.zh: 细绞铜导体可支持柔性，镀层导体则可能因温度、端接或腐蚀条件而选用。对绞、同轴结构、排流线、铝箔、编织与复合屏蔽分别解决不同耦合问题。线径应根据电流、电阻、压降、温度、束径与故障条件计算；屏蔽应按频率与接地策略定义，而不是笼统叠加。

copy.en: Materials and lay length can influence motion-generated charge in sensitive measurement cables.
copy.zh: 材料与成缆节距会影响敏感测量线缆中的运动生电噪声。

copy.en: Pigtail length, 360-degree termination, chassis bonding and isolated ends are selected for the actual circuit.
copy.zh: 屏蔽尾线长度、360 度端接、机壳搭接与隔离端需按实际回路选择。

title.en: The cleaning method must be treated as a design input
title.zh: 清洁方法必须作为设计输入

copy.en: PVC, TPE, TPU, silicone, FEP and other jackets differ in flexibility, abrasion, fluid resistance, surface feel and processing. ‘Medical grade’, ‘latex-free’ or ‘biocompatible’ are not interchangeable blanket claims. Biological evaluation depends on the finished device, nature and duration of contact, while cleanability depends on surface geometry, labels, overmold seams and the named disinfectants, concentrations, dwell times and cycle count.
copy.zh: PVC、TPE、TPU、硅胶、FEP 等护套在柔性、耐磨、耐液体、触感与加工方面各不相同。“医疗级”“不含乳胶”与“生物相容”不是可互换的笼统声明。生物学评价取决于成品器械及接触性质和时长；可清洁性则取决于表面几何、标签、包胶接缝，以及明确的消毒剂、浓度、作用时间与循环次数。

copy.en: Alcohol, bleach, peroxide, quaternary compounds and enzymatic cleaners can affect materials differently.
copy.zh: 酒精、含氯剂、过氧化物、季铵盐与酶清洗剂对材料的影响不同。

copy.en: Coupons support screening, but seams, markings, strain relief and assembled interfaces need representative evaluation.
copy.zh: 试片可用于筛选，但接缝、标识、应力消除与装配接口仍需代表性评估。

title.en: A soft jacket is not enough to guarantee flex life
title.zh: 柔软护套并不能单独保证弯折寿命

copy.en: Flex performance depends on strand construction, conductor lay, fillers, shield design, jacket thickness, cable diameter, overmold transition, bend radius and the direction of motion. A stiff connector next to a soft cable creates a concentrated strain zone. Test fixtures should reproduce the actual grip point, load, angle, speed, temperature and electrical monitoring rather than quote an unrelated cycle number.
copy.zh: 弯折性能取决于绞线结构、成缆节距、填充、屏蔽设计、护套厚度、线径、包胶过渡、弯曲半径与运动方向。硬连接器紧邻软线缆会形成应变集中区。试验夹具应复现实际握持点、负载、角度、速度、温度和电气监测，而不是引用无关的循环次数。

title.en: Move the bend away from the exit

copy.en: A progressive strain-relief profile distributes curvature instead of creating one sharp hinge.
copy.zh: 渐进式应力消除轮廓可分散曲率，避免形成单一尖锐铰点。

copy.en: Intermittent opens and resistance shifts can appear before visible jacket damage.
copy.zh: 间歇断路与电阻漂移可能早于可见护套损伤出现。

title.en: Keying, touch protection and identification reduce connection error
title.zh: 防错、防触电与标识共同降低误接风险

copy.en: Medical equipment can use circular, rectangular, push-pull, snap, clip, modular, board-to-wire and custom overmolded interfaces. Keying, color, tactile shape, insertion force, latch feedback, contact protection and cleanable grip areas should match the user and setting. A connector that is electrically adequate may still be unsuitable if it can be mis-mated, touched, trapped, disconnected unintentionally or confused in low light.
copy.zh: 医疗设备可采用圆形、矩形、推拉、自锁、夹式、模块化、板对线及定制包胶接口。防错、颜色、触觉形状、插入力、锁止反馈、触点防护与可清洁握持区域应匹配使用者和场景。即使连接器电气上合格，若可能误插、触及、夹伤、意外断开或在低照度下混淆，仍可能不适用。

title.en: Design the grip, not only the plug

copy.en: Users should pull from a defined cleanable grip instead of the cable or exposed hardware.
copy.zh: 使用者应从明确且可清洁的握持区拔插，而不是拉拽线缆或裸露硬件。

title.zh: 确认对插件与针脚编号

copy.en: Manufacturer drawing, exact part number and physical mate are reconciled before the first build.
copy.zh: 首件前核对制造商图纸、准确型号与实物对插件。

title.en: The released device file must flow into every production step
title.zh: 放行的器械文件必须落实到每一道生产工序

copy.en: Production begins with revision review, material and source confirmation, cut and strip data, termination instructions, shield and splice diagrams, overmold or heat-shrink parameters, label content and inspection hold points. Tooling, calibration, operator authorization and in-process records are linked where required. Samples and pilot lots are used to verify manufacturability before the repeat-production baseline is frozen.
copy.zh: 生产从版本审核、材料与来源确认开始，并落实裁线剥线数据、端接指导、屏蔽与接续图、包胶或热缩参数、标签内容及检验停点。按要求关联工具、校准、人员授权与过程记录。通过样品与试产验证可制造性后，再冻结重复生产基线。

copy.en: Drawing, BOM, pin table, work instruction, label file and tester program must share the authorized baseline.
copy.zh: 图纸、BOM、针脚表、作业指导、标签文件与测试程序必须使用同一授权基线。

copy.en: Crimps, shield joints, splices and soldered features are recorded before overmold or final covering.
copy.zh: 压接、屏蔽连接、接续与焊接特征应在包胶或最终包覆前完成记录。

title.en: Each test answers a defined risk-control question
title.zh: 每项测试都应对应明确的风险控制问题

copy.en: Visual and dimensional inspection confirms configuration and workmanship. Continuity and resistance verify circuit paths; insulation resistance and dielectric tests are applied only with approved limits and compatible connected hardware. Shield isolation, signal integrity, flex, pull, insertion/withdrawal, cleaning, ingress or functional tests require defined fixtures, sample quantities and acceptance criteria. A generic ‘100% tested’ statement is incomplete without the method and limit.
copy.zh: 外观与尺寸检验确认配置和工艺，导通与电阻验证回路；绝缘电阻与耐压测试只应在限值获批且所连硬件兼容时实施。屏蔽隔离、信号完整性、弯折、拉力、插拔、清洁、防护或功能测试都需要定义夹具、样本数量与接收准则。缺少方法和限值的“100% 测试”并不完整。

copy.en: High-voltage or insulation tests are not applied across sensitive circuitry without engineering authorization.
copy.zh: 未经工程授权，不得跨敏感电路实施高电压或绝缘测试。

copy.en: Tester revision, fixture, channel map, limits, environment and result make the evidence interpretable.
copy.zh: 测试机版本、夹具、通道表、限值、环境与结果共同构成可解释证据。

title.en: Risk, change and records continue after the first approved sample
title.zh: 风险、变更与记录不会在首件批准后结束

copy.en: The legal manufacturer determines the device classification, regulatory route, risk-management file and supplier controls. The cable supplier then follows the contracted configuration, record retention, lot or serial traceability, nonconformance disposition, change-notification and acceptance requirements. ISO 13485 describes a medical-device quality-management framework, while IEC 60601 addresses basic safety and essential performance for relevant medical electrical equipment; neither label automatically certifies an individual cable assembly.
copy.zh: 法定制造商确定器械分类、法规路径、风险管理文件与供应商控制；电缆供应商则遵循合同约定的配置、记录保存、批次或序列追溯、不合格处置、变更通知与验收要求。ISO 13485 描述医疗器械质量管理体系框架，IEC 60601 针对适用医用电气设备的基本安全与基本性能；任何标准名称都不会自动认证某一根电缆组件。

copy.en: Component lot, operator, tooling, inspection, tester and shipment links are defined by contract and risk.
copy.zh: 元件批次、人员、工具、检验、测试机与出货关联深度由合同和风险确定。

copy.en: Material substitution, process change, repair and rework need documented review before release.
copy.zh: 材料替代、工艺变更、修理与返工在放行前需要书面审核。

title.en: Protection, labeling and service planning complete the assembly
title.zh: 防护、标识与维修规划完成组件闭环

copy.en: Packaging prevents tight bends, connector damage, dust and mix-ups during storage and transport. The device maker specifies clean or non-sterile status, bag and label content, shelf-life controls where applicable, and whether the assembly is single-use, reusable, service-replaceable or permanently installed. Replacement cables require compatibility controls just as strict as original equipment because an apparently matching accessory can alter safety or performance.
copy.zh: 包装应防止存储与运输中的过度弯曲、连接器损伤、灰尘与混料。器械制造商需规定洁净或非无菌状态、袋装与标签内容、适用时的有效期控制，并说明组件是一次性、可重复使用、可维修更换还是永久安装。替换线缆需要与原装组件同样严格的兼容控制，因为外观匹配的附件也可能改变安全或性能。

copy.en: Tray, spool, cap, bag and carton geometry are selected around the actual connector and minimum bend radius.
copy.zh: 托盘、线轴、防尘帽、包装袋与纸箱结构应围绕实际连接器和最小弯曲半径选择。

copy.en: Part number, revision, lot or serial status and device compatibility remain readable through distribution and service.
copy.zh: 料号、版本、批次或序列状态及设备兼容信息应在流通和维修阶段保持可读。

q.en: Does ‘medical cable’ mean the assembly is already approved for patient use?
q.zh: “医疗线缆”是否表示组件已经获批用于患者？

a.en: No. It describes an application category. Intended use, patient-contact boundary, device risk controls, materials, manufacturing records and verification must be defined by the legal manufacturer and applicable regulatory route.
a.zh: 不是。它只是应用类别。预期用途、患者接触边界、器械风险控制、材料、制造记录与验证必须由法定制造商和适用法规路径确定。

q.en: Can you make ECG, SpO₂ or temperature lead sets from a sample?
q.zh: 可以依据样品制作 ECG、SpO₂ 或体温导联吗？

a.en: A sample supports interface and dimensional study, but device model, pinout, signal requirements, electrode or sensor interface, materials, cleaning method and acceptance criteria still require written confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可支持接口与尺寸研究，但设备型号、针脚、信号要求、电极或传感器接口、材料、清洁方法与验收准则仍需书面确认。

q.en: Which jacket material is best for reusable medical cables?
q.zh: 可重复使用医疗线缆最适合哪种护套？

a.en: There is no universal answer. Flex, abrasion, skin proximity, disinfectant chemistry, temperature, sterilization or cleaning cycle, color and processing all matter. Candidate materials are screened, then evaluated in the finished construction.
a.zh: 没有统一答案。弯折、耐磨、皮肤接近、消毒剂化学、温度、灭菌或清洁循环、颜色与加工都需考虑。候选材料先筛选，再在成品结构中评价。

q.en: Can every assembly be hipot tested?
q.zh: 每种组件都可以做耐压测试吗？

a.en: No. Test voltage, duration, ramp, leakage limit and connection method must suit the insulation system and any connected electronics. Sensitive circuitry may require a different method or engineering isolation.
a.zh: 不可以。测试电压、时间、爬升、漏电限值与连接方式必须适合绝缘系统及所连电子部件；敏感电路可能需要其他方法或工程隔离。

q.en: Can one connector be used across several monitor brands?
q.zh: 一种连接器可以通用于多个监护仪品牌吗？

a.en: Only after exact model, mating hardware, keying, pin assignment, signal behavior and accessory-identification requirements are confirmed. Physical fit alone is insufficient and can create a hazardous misconnection.
a.zh: 只有在确认准确型号、对插硬件、防错、针脚、信号行为与附件识别要求后才可以。仅能物理插入并不足够，还可能造成危险误接。

q.en: What should we send for the first engineering review?
q.zh: 首次工程审核需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Send device and intended-use information, target markets, interface drawings or samples, pin and shield schedule, electrical data, patient-contact boundary, cable geometry, cleaning and flex duty, material restrictions, labeling, traceability, quantity and verification requirements.
a.zh: 请提供设备与预期用途、目标市场、接口图纸或样品、针脚与屏蔽表、电气数据、患者接触边界、线缆几何、清洁与弯折工况、材料限制、标签、追溯、数量及验证要求。
